note: Coverage of the decisions of the 61 municipal councils (Law 139/2015, art. 15(2) and 18(3): each council publishes its acts on its own official website; there is no state-run register). Published: decisions on main. Held: decisions found but not published, by reason (data/held.json lists each). www.vendime.al, a national archive of council decisions run by a non-governmental organisation, is not used.
